The '''BN-T0 Utility Droid''' was a model of utility droid which was around during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />
{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The BN-T0 Utility Droid appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It was added to the game with the release of the "Master The Fight" Bundle on [[November 25]], [[2025]].<ref name="Bundle">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251125-0|text=The Master the Fight: Mobile Market bundle is now available!}}</ref>
